metricDefinition.timing: RMSE of phase-locked extrema times relative to the accepted anchor extremum
metricDefinition.amplitude: RMSE of phase-locked pressure deviations from each run tail baseline
metricDefinition.visibleDuration: distance of the last modeled extremum at or above 0.5 kPa from the user-confirmed clear-to-faint visibility interval; values inside the interval receive no penalty
metricDefinition.score: mean run score: timing/1.5 ms + amplitude/0.75 kPa + visible-duration error/30 ms
metricDefinition.fittedNuisanceParameter: one equivalent release amplitude per real run; it is not interpreted as the recorded t=0 displacement
